role_guidance.focus.campaign_user: Run approved campaigns and confirm delivery status.
role_guidance.focus.data_engineer: Validate defaults and integration readiness before execution.
role_guidance.focus.ml_analyst: Review model and policy governance before activating changes.
role_guidance.focus.admin_operator: Own active defaults, lifecycle actions, and controlled promotion or rollback.
role_guidance.action.campaign.trigger_ru: Launch a campaign with approved defaults or explicit governed overrides.
role_guidance.action.campaign.recent_run: Check run status, policy outcome, and export or delivery completion.
role_guidance.action.campaign.delivery: Confirm delivered rows and review per-run delivery records.
role_guidance.action.data_engineer.defau: Inspect and set default policy, integration profile, and delivery target.
role_guidance.action.data_engineer.readi: Review runtime_runnable and readiness mode for connectors and profiles.
role_guidance.action.data_engineer.contr: Inspect feature, policy, and audience definition version lifecycle states.
role_guidance.action.ml_analyst.control_: Review embedding or model versions and inspect governance readiness or blockers.
role_guidance.action.ml_analyst.explain: Inspect policy decisions and audit evidence for specific run or customer cases.
role_guidance.action.ml_analyst.readines: Validate runtime compatibility before recommending promotion.
role_guidance.action.admin.dashboard: Start from readiness snapshot, selected defaults, and primary orchestration entrypoint.
role_guidance.action.admin.control_plane: Execute validated lifecycle transitions and record governance evidence.
role_guidance.action.admin.explain: Review lifecycle and delivery audit records during incident response.
journey.dashboard.title: Journey: Start Here
journey.dashboard.summary: Use this snapshot to confirm runnable paths before changing defaults or triggering runs.
journey.dashboard.step_1: Confirm at least one runnable integration profile and delivery target.
journey.dashboard.step_2: Verify selected defaults match the current campaign or UAT objective.
journey.dashboard.step_3: Open Trigger Run for execution or Control-Plane Versions for lifecycle/governance review.
journey.defaults.title: Journey: Inspect Defaults
journey.defaults.summary: Defaults are the baseline for both API-triggered and UI-triggered runs.
journey.defaults.step_1: Verify default policy version is approved for this test window.
journey.defaults.step_2: Choose implemented integration and delivery defaults only.
journey.defaults.step_3: Save and then trigger a run to verify the new default path behaves as expected.
journey.control_plane.title: Journey: Inspect Versions and Governance
journey.control_plane.summary: Use list and detail views to inspect lifecycle state and activation blockers before promotion.
journey.control_plane.step_1: Filter by entity family and key to locate the exact version under review.
journey.control_plane.step_2: Open detail to inspect promotion readiness checks, blockers, and non-blocking gaps.
journey.control_plane.step_3: Record evidence first, then run lifecycle actions only when governance is ready.
journey.trigger_run.title: Journey: Trigger a Run
journey.trigger_run.summary: Trigger uses saved defaults unless you provide explicit override values.
journey.trigger_run.step_1: Enter campaign_id and requested_size for the test.
journey.trigger_run.step_2: Leave overrides blank for default-path testing, or set approved version overrides.
journey.trigger_run.step_3: After completion, validate outcome in Recent Runs and Delivery.
journey.recent_runs.title: Journey: Review Recent Runs
journey.recent_runs.summary: Use this table to validate run status and identify follow-up pages for deeper checks.
journey.recent_runs.step_1: Check run status and last failure first for quick triage.
journey.recent_runs.step_2: Validate policy/integration/delivery versions match expected defaults or overrides.
journey.recent_runs.step_3: If needed, open Delivery and Explain/Audit for deeper evidence.
journey.delivery.title: Journey: Review Delivery
journey.delivery.summary: Use run_id filtering to trace job, attempt, and record-level delivery outcomes.
journey.delivery.step_1: Filter by run_id when verifying a specific campaign test.
journey.delivery.step_2: Compare rows attempted, delivered, and skipped for integrity checks.
journey.delivery.step_3: If missing records or failures appear, cross-check Recent Runs and readiness state.
journey.explain.title: Journey: Explain and Audit
journey.explain.summary: Use this page for policy explain lookups and governance/lifecycle audit review.
journey.explain.step_1: Lookup policy decision with run_id plus customer_id for explain detail.
journey.explain.step_2: Review lifecycle audit actions for promotion or rollback traceability.
journey.explain.step_3: Review delivery audit attempts to confirm downstream execution evidence.
journey.readiness.title: Journey: Check Readiness
journey.readiness.summary: Use runtime_runnable and readiness_mode to separate blockers from planning-only entries.
journey.readiness.step_1: Confirm required integration profile and delivery target are runtime_runnable=true.
journey.readiness.step_2: Treat not_implemented entries as non-runnable and out of current UAT scope.
journey.readiness.step_3: Resolve readiness blockers before triggering runs or promoting new defaults.
journey.default.title: Journey Guidance
journey.default.summary: Use role entry points to choose the right page for your current UAT task.
journey.default.step_1: Select the surface aligned to your role and objective.
journey.default.step_2: Capture blockers with exact run_id or version_id context.
journey.default.step_3: Use Explain/Audit and Control-Plane detail pages for evidence-backed decisions.
uat.panel_subtitle: This status panel is implementation-honest for internal UAT execution. It does not imply persona-scoped RBAC.
uat.scenario.uat1.name: Campaign User run and outcome review
uat.scenario.uat1.caveats: Requires runnable defaults and implemented integration/delivery entries. Delivery run_id filter expects UUID format.
uat.scenario.uat2.name: Data Engineer defaults and readiness validation
uat.scenario.uat2.caveats: Only implemented profiles/targets are selectable in Defaults. Planned entries stay visible for planning context.
uat.scenario.uat3.name: ML Analyst governance and explain review
uat.scenario.uat3.caveats: Explain lookup requires both run_id and customer_id. Governance detail depends on available registry version rows.
uat.scenario.uat4.name: Admin/Operator lifecycle and governance control
uat.scenario.uat4.caveats: Activation is intentionally blocked when governance checks fail or evidence is missing.
uat.scenario.uat5.name: Provider/model visibility across readiness and registry
uat.scenario.uat5.caveats: Requires at least one model or embedding-model version in the registry for detail validation.
